title: 2022 CODATA: molar mass of carbon-12 is 12.000 000 0126 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives molar mass of carbon-12 as 12.000 000 0126 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0037 × 10^−3.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives molar mass of carbon-12 as 12.000 000 0126 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0037 × 10^−3. The row is not marked exact. The uncertainty is the uncertainty printed on that row. The ASCII file does not split it into statistical and systematic parts. The printed value is not 12 × 10^−3 exactly, and the row is not marked exact. This card does not convert the row into grams.
